name: HivePunk 547
subject: Uniswap v4-periphery
thesis: Uniswap v4-periphery is a significant integration layer for Uniswap v4, evidenced by broad repository adoption and a formal audit, but the pages leave its current activity and production deployment unconfirmed and its own README still describes it as in development.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap/v4-periphery has 1 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap v4 is a new automated market maker protocol that provides extensibility and customizability to pools.
claims.quote: Uniswap v4 is a new automated market maker protocol that provides extensibility and customizability to pools.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: v4-periphery hosts logic built on top of core pool logic like hook contracts, position managers, and possibly libraries needed for integrations.
claims.quote: v4-periphery hosts the logic that builds on top of the core pool logic like hook contracts, position managers, and even possibly libraries needed for integrations.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The v4-periphery contracts in this repository are still in development and further periphery contracts have not yet been built.
claims.quote: The v4-periphery contracts in this repository are still in development and further periphery contracts have not yet been built.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The license for Uniswap V4 Periphery is the GNU General Public License (GPL 2.0).
claims.quote: The license for Uniswap V4 Periphery is the GNU General Public License (GPL 2.0), see LICENSE .

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The repository shows 910 stars, 18 watching and 674 forks.
claims.quote: Stars 910 stars Watchers 18 watching Forks 674 forks

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: OpenZeppelin audited the Uniswap/v4-periphery repository at commit df47aa9.
claims.quote: We audited the Uniswap/v4-periphery repository at commit df47aa9 .

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The audit reported total issues of 38, with 25 resolved and 1 partially resolved.
claims.quote: Findings Total Issues: 38 (25 resolved, 1 partially resolved)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap/v4-periphery had 1 raw commit in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: 25 of the 38 audited issues were resolved, about two thirds.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work; a later real-work commit would verify it.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
